text: dsh-plugin-longgraph 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的社区技能插件，通过 Cordis 将技能提供器注册到 ctx.skills。它加载并提供 longgraph、loop-graph 和 loop-converge 三项作者技能，供用户或模型查询完整的技能说明。loop-graph 帮助把长期任务整理成执行者、监督者、台账和指令文件；loop-converge 提供代码收敛预设。适合需要持续推进、审查或整理代码的 Harness 用户。安装后无需额外运行时配置。

dsh-plugin-longgraph registers three authoring skills with DeepSeek Harness: longgraph, loop-graph, and loop-converge. They help structure long-running work with executor and supervisor roles, and provide a code-convergence preset. The skills registry serves their full instructions.
我想把一个跨很多轮的开发目标拆成持续跟进的步骤。
能不能让两个独立智能体分别执行工作和检查进度？
希望把长期任务的状态和后续指令保存在上下文之外。
想给重复多轮的工作设定里程碑和独立验收流程。
有没有办法系统整理代码里的重复实现和无用部分？
让 Harness 提供一个帮助规划长期智能体工作的技能。
I need a durable workflow for a software project that will take many rounds to complete.
Help me plan a code cleanup effort focused on removing duplication and unused pieces.
dsh-plugin-longgraph 的功能「长周期任务图」：把长期目标组织为执行者、监督者以及共享台账和指令文件。调用 loop-graph 技能后进行访谈并生成运行文件和可复制的 Harness 提示词。
dsh-plugin-longgraph 的功能「代码收敛预设」：为长期清理任务绑定减少重复和未使用代码的目标，并要求设置独立监督者。用户调用 loop-converge 技能时进入范围、权限和启动方式的访谈。
dsh-plugin-longgraph 的功能「Harness 技能注册」：插件加载时向 ctx.skills 注册提供器，列出三个打包技能，并按名称读取其说明内容。技能可供用户或模型调用。

dsh-plugin-longgraph README · dsh-plugin-longgraph：English · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Community **DeepSeek Harness** plugin that registers the longgraph authoring
skills on `ctx.skills`.

> Community plugin. Not affiliated with or maintained by DeepSeek AI.

This package is **DeepSeek Harness only**. It does not install or launch
nodes on any other product.

dsh-plugin-longgraph README · dsh-plugin-longgraph：[longgraph](https://github.com/levi-qiao/longgraph-skill) is a prompt
library for long-horizon agent work: an executor node, a ledger, and a
clean-context supervisor connected by a one-way directives edge. Each
node owns one timer. There is no wake edge between them. This plugin
does not add an agent runtime — it exposes that library through the
Harness skill seam.

dsh-plugin-longgraph README · Skills：After the plugin loads, `ctx.skills.list()` / `snapshot()` advertise:

| Name | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `longgraph` | Fit check, then hand off to `loop-graph` |
| `loop-graph` | Interview → compile `.longgraph/<date-slug>/` → launch or print DSH prompts |
| `loop-converge` | Code-convergence preset, then the same compile |

dsh-plugin-longgraph README · Skills：`get` / the model-facing `skill({ name })` path returns the full instruction
body. `resourceBase` points at the packaged skill directory so templates
and [`references/deepseek-harness.md`](skills/loop-graph/references/deepseek-harness.md)
resolve.

dsh-plugin-longgraph README · Install：DeepSeek Harness is in developer preview. This plugin pins
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` `>=0.1.0-rc.5 <0.2.0` and is tested against
the public `0.1.0-rc.6` line.

dsh-plugin-longgraph README · Profile bundle (recommended)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:levi-qiao/dsh-plugin-longgraph
dsh --profile web
```

Then invoke `skill({ name: "longgraph" })` (or `loop-graph` /
`loop-converge`).

`package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`. The shipped
`cordis.patch.yml` inserts one row named `dsh-plugin-longgraph`. Profile
composition applies that layer before the profile's own patch.

Pin a git commit when you want a frozen install:

dsh-plugin-longgraph README · Profile bundle (recommended)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:levi-qiao/dsh-plugin-longgraph#<commit>
```

Git installs fetch source, so `prepare` runs `tsdown`. With pnpm 10+, add
the package to the profile `pnpm-workspace.yaml` build allowlist if pnpm
blocks `prepare`, then retry.

dsh-plugin-longgraph README · Direct Cordis row：```yaml
- id: longgraph-skills
  name: dsh-plugin-longgraph
```

The plugin `inject`s `skills` and calls `ctx.skills.registerProvider`.
It has no runtime config.

dsh-plugin-longgraph README · Timers on DeepSeek Harness：Two independent **root sessions**, two `schedule_create` clocks:

- `every_seconds` floor is 300 (five minutes).
- Schedule is session-local — both sessions must stay live.
- A busy session waits until idle, then `followup()`. The timer does not
  interrupt a fire.
- Never `followup()` / `inject()` the other session. The executor reads
  new directives on its next fire.

See [the host reference](skills/loop-graph/references/deepseek-harness.md).

dsh-plugin-longgraph README · Compatibility：| Peer | Range |
| --- | --- |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `>=4.0.1 <5` |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` | `>=0.1.0-rc.5 <0.2.0` |

Harness remains a developer preview. Compatibility-breaking changes will
require a new plugin version.

dsh-plugin-longgraph README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm build

`pnpm test` loads the shipped `apply` against a real `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill`
`SkillRegistry` and reads the packaged `SKILL.md` files. `pnpm integration`
boots the same plugin through the public Cordis Loader.

dsh-plugin-longgraph README · What this is not：- Not a DeepSeek AI product and not an official Harness bundle.
- Not a replacement for `dsh-agent-loop`, Schedule, Jobs, or the Web UI.
- Not a multi-host skill pack. The sibling
  [longgraph-skill](https://github.com/levi-qiao/longgraph-skill) repo
  remains the multi-host prompt library.

dsh-plugin-longgraph README · dsh-plugin-longgraph：[English](README.md) · 简体中文

面向 **DeepSeek Harness** 的社区插件：把 longgraph 作者技能注册到
`ctx.skills`。

> 社区插件，与 DeepSeek AI 无隶属关系，亦非其维护。

本包 **只适配 DeepSeek Harness**，不会在其他产品上安装或拉起节点。

[longgraph](https://github.com/levi-qiao/longgraph-skill) 是一套长周期
智能体提示词库：执行节点、台账、干净上下文的监督节点，只通过单向
directives 边相连。每个节点自己有一口钟，彼此不唤醒。本插件不加运行时，
只通过 Harness 的 skill 缝把这份库暴露出去。

dsh-plugin-longgraph README · 技能：插件加载后，`ctx.skills.list()` / `snapshot()` 会列出：

| 名称 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `longgraph` | 适配检查，然后交给 `loop-graph` |
| `loop-graph` | 面试 → 编译 `.longgraph/<日期-slug>/` → 拉起或打印 DSH 提示词 |
| `loop-converge` | 代码收敛预设，再走同一套编译 |

`get` / 模型侧的 `skill({ name })` 返回完整指令正文。`resourceBase`
指向打包进去的技能目录，这样模板和
[`references/deepseek-harness.md`](skills/loop-graph/references/deepseek-harness.md)
可以按相对路径解析。

dsh-plugin-longgraph README · 安装：DeepSeek Harness 目前是开发者预览。本插件将 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill`
钉在 `>=0.1.0-rc.5 <0.2.0`，并对照公开的 `0.1.0-rc.6` 线验证。

dsh-plugin-longgraph README · Profile bundle（推荐）：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:levi-qiao/dsh-plugin-longgraph
dsh --profile web
```

然后调用 `skill({ name: "longgraph" })`（或 `loop-graph` /
`loop-converge`）。

`package.json` 声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`。随包的 `cordis.patch.yml`
插入一行 `name: dsh-plugin-longgraph`。Profile 组合先应用这一层，再应用
profile 自己的 patch。

需要冻结版本时钉 commit：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:levi-qiao/dsh-plugin-longgraph#<commit>
```

dsh-plugin-longgraph README · Profile bundle（推荐）：从 Git 安装会拉源码，因此 `prepare` 会跑 `tsdown`。pnpm 10+ 若拦截
`prepare`，把该包装进 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` `allowBuilds` 后再试。

dsh-plugin-longgraph README · 直接写 Cordis 行：```yaml
- id: longgraph-skills
  name: dsh-plugin-longgraph
```

插件 `inject` 的是 `skills`，调用 `ctx.skills.registerProvider`。没有运行时配置。

dsh-plugin-longgraph README · DeepSeek Harness 上的定时器：两个独立的 **根会话**，两口 `schedule_create` 钟：

- `every_seconds` 下限是 300（五分钟）。
- Schedule 是 session-local——两个会话都要保持在线。
- 会话正忙时，到期的 `every` 会等到空闲再 `followup()`，不会打断当次 fire。
- 绝不对另一个会话 `followup()` / `inject()`。执行节点在下一次 fire 读新的 directives。

见 [宿主 reference](skills/loop-graph/references/deepseek-harness.md)。

dsh-plugin-longgraph README · 兼容性：| Peer | 范围 |
| --- | --- |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `>=4.0.1 <5` |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` | `>=0.1.0-rc.5 <0.2.0` |

Harness 仍是开发者预览。破坏性变更需要发新的插件版本。

dsh-plugin-longgraph README · 开发：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm build

`pnpm test` 用真实的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` `SkillRegistry` 加载随包的
`apply`，并读取打包进去的 `SKILL.md`。`pnpm integration` 用公开的 Cordis
Loader 再启动同一份插件。

dsh-plugin-longgraph README · 这不是什么：- 不是 DeepSeek AI 产品，也不是官方 Harness bundle。
- 不替换 `dsh-agent-loop`、Schedule、Jobs 或 Web UI。
- 不是多宿主技能包。多宿主提示词库仍在
  [longgraph-skill](https://github.com/levi-qiao/longgraph-skill)。
